question: How many users are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users;

question: How many users have placed orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyers FROM orders;

question: What is the average review rating for each product?
sql: SELECT p.name, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.name;

question: Total revenue by store region
sql: SELECT s.region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.region;

question: Top 5 products by units sold
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Monthly revenue in 2024
sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

question: Which marketing channels are paid?
sql: SELECT channel_name FROM marketing_channels WHERE is_paid;

question: Conversion rate from sessions to orders by channel
sql: SELECT mc.channel_name, SUM(d.orders_count)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(d.sessions), 0) AS conversion_rate FROM daily_channel_metrics d JOIN marketing_channels mc ON mc.id = d.channel_id GROUP BY mc.channel_name;

question: How many orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';

question: Average order value per customer segment
sql: SELECT u.customer_segment, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.customer_segment;

question: Number of active products per category
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS active_products FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.is_active GROUP BY c.name;

question: List the stores in Europe
sql: SELECT name FROM stores WHERE region = 'Europe';

question: Which customers wrote verified reviews?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.email FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.is_verified;

question: Revenue by source category per day
sql: SELECT metric_date, source_category, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM store_channel_sales GROUP BY metric_date, source_category ORDER BY metric_date;
